versions.name: Wilderness Survival
versions.description: Spend a night in a shelter improvised from what the woods provide, light fires without matches, treat water three ways, signal aircraft overhead, and keep panic from turning trouble into disaster.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
